minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, October 16th, 2024.

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order
  at: 10:00 AM on Wednesday, October 16th, 2024.

  Members present: Edward Padgett, Bette Donovan, Scott Snider, Terry Kistler,
  George Borst, Jenny Jolly.

  Members Absent:

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Director, Armando
  Cisneros, Community Services Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Community
  Services Specialist.

  It was moved by Scott Snider and seconded by Edward Padgett to approve the
  minutes of the Wednesday, September 18th, 2024 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Paulina Ale, MHSA Program Coordinator, Innovation, Tri-City.

3. Tri-City serves Claremont, La Verne and Pomona. Paulina gave an overview of
  the programs at Tri-City and informed us of the new programs being
  introduced as a result of 1.5 million dollars allocated towards mental health
  projects. Paulina holds many community outreach events including focus
  groups to further involve input from the local community and to get a better
  idea on the immediate needs of the community. Many participants are also able
  to win a Samsung Galaxy Tablet if you do conduct the short survey.

  Unfinished Business

4. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 526 Meals were served to an average of 22 participants in
  September.

  Meals on Wheels: 593 Meals were served/delivered in September.

5. Bingo Report: The total balance in the account through October 16th, 2024
  was $15.80. Liabilities to Bingo West was $405.00. Liabilities to City of La
  Verne, $448. The average attendance for September was 53 players per
  week.
 6. Account Balance: $1921.39.

7. Senior Program Fees: All programs are paid for September.

8. MT. SAC Classes: Registration for Winter/Spring classes will be on 11/22/24 from
  11:30AM-1:30PM. Mt. Sac Classes will be offering fee-based classes in the next
  weeks.

9. Aging Next: 11 La Verne residents were served in September with 5 served
  via the Joslyn Center and 6 served via Aging Next office.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: The Grand Opening of the playground at La Flores park is
  scheduled for mid-November.

11. Upcoming Events:

  •  Tuesday, October 17th – Excursion, Fall Fun in Julian, 8:00AM-6:30PM.
  •  Friday, October 18th – Senior Seminar, Prop 19, JohnHart Real Estate, 9:30AM.
  •  Friday, October 25th – Senior Seminar, PVTA Talk, Presented by PVTA, 9:30AM.
  •  Friday, November 1st – Senior Dinner Dance: Midnight Masquerade, 4:00PM.
  •  Friday, November 8th – Senior Seminar, Medicare Information, TMB Insurance, 9:30AM.
  •  Tuesday, November 12th – Excursion, Valley View Casino, 8:30AM-6:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, November 13th – Senior Seminar, Active Every Day, Independence at Home, 9:30AM.
  •  Monday, November 18th – Movie Matinee: Skyfall, 12:30PM.

  Public Comments: Bette Donovan raised the questions of the committee’s
  quorum needed for Voting. Liz Pavon had questions regarding the police
  department.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:40AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, January 15th, 2025 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Community Services Specialist
